description: A plain native <ol> with no start/reversed — produces the exact same GND shape as list-html-native's <ul> (both map to a bare "list" role via simpleElementTypeRoles, with no ordered/unordered distinction preserved anywhere in the schema). This is the baseline that any future listItem position-numbering feature has to solve first: whether to speak a number at all depends on knowing the list was ordered, which the GND format currently cannot express
